description: The plot illustrates how the **Average Repetition Rate** varies across **Relation Category** indices for three experimental settings, with additional horizontal reference lines showing the average level for each setting. The x-axis is labeled **“Relation Category”** and uses a linear scale with integer categories spanning roughly **0 to 65**, with labeled ticks at regular intervals of about **10** (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60). The y-axis is labeled **“Average Repetition Rate”** on a linear scale ranging from **0.0 to 0.6**, with evenly spaced tick marks at **0.1** increments. Three main lines are shown: a **blue solid line with small circular markers** labeled **“w/o DPO obo”**, which fluctuates substantially, starting near **0.24** at category 0, spiking to about **0.60** around category 1, dipping near **0.06–0.10** in early categories, showing another prominent peak near **0.62** around category 31, and ending near **0.05** at the final category; an **orange solid line with small triangular markers** labeled **“w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”**, which oscillates between roughly **0.05 and 0.60**, beginning around **0.15–0.20**, reaching a high near **0.58–0.60** around category 31, showing multiple mid-to-late peaks around **0.40–0.47** (e.g., in the 30s and mid-40s), and finishing around **0.15**; and a **green solid line with small triangular markers** labeled **“DPO”**, which stays lower and more tightly clustered, starting around **0.28–0.30** at category 0, dropping to around **0.06–0.10** shortly after, then varying mostly between about **0.07 and 0.18** through the remainder and ending near **0.06–0.08**. Three **dotted horizontal lines** indicate averages: a **blue dotted** line labeled **“Average of w/o DPO obo”** at approximately **0.163**, an **orange dotted** line labeled **“Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”** at approximately **0.227**, and a **green dotted** line labeled **“Average of DPO”** at approximately **0.117**, with these numeric values also annotated near the left side of the plot in matching colors.
